text:
Olivia (Sales): Heads-up - EdgeFjord wants to kick off the joint POC. They need a shared pilot tenant, SAML SSO, VPC peering/egress allowlist, and telemetry exports for usage reconciliation. Can eng/infra triage?
Alex (EdgeFjord): Yep. Primary goals: validate SSO login flow, confirm egress rules for model calls, and get an estimated token burn for budgeting. POC traffic estimate: ~100k requests/day, ~300 tokens per request. No streaming for now.
Sam (Eng-Platform): Quick clarifying Qs: which model fidelity are you testing (gpt-large equivalent as discussed?) and do you expect KV caching (session-based) to be used? Also what's p95 latency target?
Alex (EdgeFjord): Confirm gpt-large equivalent, KV caching enabled where possible, p95 target ~200ms.
Marta (Eng-Infra): For networking we'll need their partner CIDRs and IdP metadata. We can provision a staging tenant in eu-west-1 and set up VPC peering. Minimum allowlist suggestion:
```
- Redwood egress: 34.82.10.0/24, 34.82.11.0/24
- Redwood API endpoints: api.redwood.example:443
- Partner CIDR: <partner to provide>
```
Jess (Partnerships): On billing - do they want strict usage-based pricing or a short committed slot? Olivia?
Olivia (Sales): They prefer usage-based for the POC but need a cost projection. If they convert to a short reservation later that's ok. Can eng provide a rough token cost for 2 weeks?
Sam (Eng-Platform): Rough calc: 100k reqs/day * 300 tokens = 30M tokens/day. At illustrative $0.0006/token -> $18k/day -> ~$252k over 14 days. With batching + prefix caching we often cut 30-50%. I can run a perf sim to give a refined number.
Raj (Solutions): I'll run the perf sim. Need sample prompts + traffic distribution. Alex, can you drop a sample set to the shared drive?
Alex (EdgeFjord): Just uploaded sample prompts and a small trace file. Also forwarding our NetOps contact and IdP metadata shortly.
Marta (Eng-Infra): Security questionnaire notes for KMS / audit / residency:
- KMS: Hosted supports provider-managed KMS (AWS/GCP); Private supports customer-managed keys and HSM.
- Audit logs: Request-level logs, model routing and billing metrics; exports to S3, HTTPS endpoint, or syslog.
- Data residency: Hosted regions in EU/US; Private/VPC option for strict residency.
Jess (Partnerships): I'll compile those bullets into their questionnaire. Any short runbook snippets we can share for tenant provisioning?
Sam (Eng-Platform): Tenant provisioning curl for Raj to automate: 
```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.example/api/v1/tenants \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"name":"edgefjord-poc","region":"eu-west-1","allowed_cidrs":["PARTNER_CIDR"]}'
```
Marta (Eng-Infra): Estimate for setup work: SSO config + verification: 1 day. VPC peering and firewall allowlist: 1 day (may depend on partner NetOps SLA). Tenant + KMS setup: 0.5 day. Telemetry export and billing hook: 0.5 day. Total ~3 working days if no hold-ups.
Raj (Solutions): I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff to collect prompts, runbook access, and confirm telemetry fields. Please confirm who can attend: @Sam, @Marta, @Jess.
Sam (Eng-Platform): I'll join to scope perf + batching configs.
Jess (Partnerships): I'll join to capture enablement artifacts for EdgeFjord.
Alex (EdgeFjord): Sending IdP metadata and NetOps contact now. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
deploy-bot: Created meeting "EdgeFjord POC kickoff" scheduled for 2024-06-12 10:00 UTC.
Olivia (Sales): I'll make a GH runbook page with these notes and action items and assign follow-ups. Will ping when done. :thumbsup:
Alex (EdgeFjord): Thanks team, talk soon.
